First, subtract 6 months from 1746-06-09:  
1746-06-09 → 1745-12-09 (since June minus 6 months = December of previous year).  

Then subtract 27 days from 1745-12-09:  
1745-12-09 minus 9 days → 1745-11-30.  
Remaining 18 days (27 total - 9 days) → 1745-11-30 minus 18 days = 1745-11-12.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1745-11-12
